FIRST AMENDMENT
to Contract for Security Guards Services
by and between
ZIMS Security (Private) Limited (the "First Party") and Dubizzle Labs (SMC-Private)
Limited (formerly known as EMGP LABS (SMC-Private) Limited) (the "Second Party")
[Each a Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first (ist) amendment (the "First Amendment") to the Contract for Security Guards Services
dated 8th February, 2022 (the "Contract") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 29th March,
2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Contract for security services to be provided by First Party to
make available Security Staff at the Locations specified by the Second Party on such
terms and conditions as agreed in writing between the Parties from time to time; and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Contract as per the terms and
conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force from 1 January, 2023.

2.

The Term of the Contract is hereby further extended for a period of one (1) year commencing
from l January, 2023 and ending on 31st December, 2024 ('Term").

3.

From l April, 2024, the rates for security services agreed between the Parties are as
follows:
Sr#

Category

Rates (excluding GST)

1

Ex-Army Guard

42,764 per month

2

Civil Guard

41,653 per month

3

Close Protection Officer (CPO)

3000 per day

4

Metal Detector

1000 Per Detector Per Month
(10 to 15 pcs Complimentary)

5

UVSM (Walkie talkie set)

1200 Per Month

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Contract.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Contract shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in
the Contract shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Contract shall bear the same meaning in
this First Amendment, u -.: . herwise specified herein.

make available Security Staff at the Locations specified by the Second Party on such

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Contract as per the terms and
conditions of this Second Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Second Amendment shall come into force on 14th December, 2022.

2.

The Term of the Contract is hereby further extended for a period of two (2) years and six (6)
months commencing from
December, 2022 and ending on 13th June, 2025 ("Term").

3.

From 1st April, 2024, the rates for security services agreed between the Parties are as
